overloads.semanticRole: Max returns the maximum value in series .

constraints: attributePath is only meaningful when series is an object field; it defines a dot-notation path (e.g. "company.address.number") to a nested attribute whose values are aggregated across the selection. Attribute names are case-sensitive.
Non-numeric values found at the attribute path are ignored; only numeric attribute values are computed.
Returns 0 if the series selection is empty.
